decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Survey - Existing Arrangement, Proposals - Plan, Rear and Side Elevations, Proposals - Roof Plan and Side Elevation, received 21/08/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The side walls of the extension shall be fitted with obscure glazing during construction and shall contain no openable windows and shall be so retained permanently
description: Erection of a conservatory at the rear of the house
